assessments.name: Viva Voce for Clinical examination
assessments.description: Viva Voce (Oral Examination) for DENT6389. You must have available all appropriate analogue and digital records for the presented patients for examination.

assessments.name: Clinical Assessment of Cases
assessments.description: Clinical Evaluation of patients. All treatment notes, radiographs and plans as well as analogue and digital preoperative, records must be appropriately prepared and available for examination. Chairside questions by examiners must be expected.

assessments.name: Continuous Clinical Assessment for DENT 6371
assessments.description: Continued Clinical skills assessment. Engagement is expected with your supervisor preoperatively, intraoperatively and postoperatively. Ensure that you are prepared for each clinical session.
assessments.type: Peer or expert observation or supervision

assessments.name: Log Book and Case Reports
assessments.description:
AANZP Case Report Format. No limit on length of report. Comprehensive case report of history, examination, diagnosis, problem list, treatment plan and sequence as well your case reflections.

AANZP Log Book format
assessments.length: AANZP Case Report Format. No limit.
